**1 — Scene:** A breakfast of toast, a fried egg and avocado, with a small bowl of peach slices and a milky coffee. I include the bowl and drink because they are part of the same tray.

**2 — Vessels:** Estimated plate diameter **22 cm**, area **380 cm²**; fruit bowl **10 cm**, area **79 cm²**; cup interior **8 cm**, area **50 cm²**.

**3 — Items:** Toast (apparently two stacked slices), one fried egg, avocado, peach slices and milky coffee. No separate butter, sauce or oil quantity is clearly visible; the egg’s energy estimate includes frying fat.

**4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy:** Heights represent the food’s average outer envelope. Density is the only volume-to-weight reduction.

| Item | Vessel area covered | Area × height = volume | Density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Toast | 30% of plate | 114 × 2.2 = 251 ml | 0.30 | 75 g | 290 | 218 kcal |
| Fried egg | 20% of plate | 76 × 0.75 = 57 ml | 0.98 | 56 g | 196 | 110 kcal |
| Avocado | 15% of plate | 57 × 1.2 = 68 ml | 0.95 | 65 g | 160 | 104 kcal |
| Peach slices, likely canned | 65% of bowl | 51 × 2 = 102 ml | 0.65 | 66 g | 60 | 40 kcal |
| Milky coffee | 100% of cup interior | 50 × 5 = 250 ml | 1.03 | 258 g | 45 | 116 kcal |

The plate coverage totals **65%**, consistent with the visible uncovered areas. Bowl and cup coverage are counted separately.

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **262 g of solid food**, plus **258 g of coffee**, is plausible for the portions shown. Estimated total: **520 g and 588 kcal**. Toast thickness and the coffee’s milk content are the largest uncertainties.
